sys_script_fix.name: Delete Duplicate Record
sys_script_fix.script: var duplicate_records = new GlideRecord('incident'); duplicate_records.addQuery('short_description', 'Accenture'); // field_name, the duplicate parameter to be recognized duplicate_records.orderBy('sys_created_on'); //order by field duplicate_records.setLimit(1); // set a limit of how many record to retain duplicate_records.query(); // query result duplicate_records.deleteMultiple(); //delete the duplicate records apart from the set limit
